_comment: Doppler — flagged-domain routing fragment. Merge into each node's xray-core config (the config Marzban feeds xray). ChatGPT/OpenAI (and other datacenter-IP-flagged) domains exit through a clean upstream; EVERYTHING ELSE keeps the fast direct/freedom path. See README.md for how to merge, fill placeholders, and verify. This file is version-controlled config, NOT secrets — replace the placeholder host/user/pass at deploy time from the node's env file, never commit real credentials.

outbounds._comment: Clean off-Azure node or static-ISP proxy. address/port/user/pass are PLACEHOLDERS — substitute from /etc/doppler-xray-upstream.env at deploy (see README). Use protocol 'http' instead of 'socks' if the provider only exposes an HTTP proxy (same settings shape).

routing._comment: PREPEND these rules ahead of the node's existing rules so flagged domains match first. Requires the inbound to have sniffing enabled (destOverride: tls/http) so xray sees the SNI/host — Marzban's VLESS-Reality inbound has this on by default. 'domain:' matches the domain and all subdomains.
